summary: Phase 2 frontend-only verification of inner pages + new ShipStory scroll sequence for Tech Yugantar. All 8 inner routes (/about, /services, /how-we-work, /projects, /case-study/loexa-africa, /pricing, /blog, /contact) return HTTP 200 with zero uncaught page errors and zero non-HMR console errors. Redesigned Breadcrumb renders on About/Services/Projects/How-We-Work with the required 'Home > PageName' pill (Home links to '/'), the large Clash Display title, and the aurora glow + grid backdrop; readable in both dark and light. The new scroll-pinned 'How We Ship' sequence (data-testid=ship-story, 300vh) works: scrolling triggers stage highlighting exactly as spec — at ~0% stage-0 (We Build) is active, at ~40% stage-1 (We Measure), at ~70% and ~95% stage-2 (We Scale). All three stages are reachable, layout is intact, no errors. 'How We Communicate' and the 8-step 'From Idea to Shipped Product' timeline both still render below the ShipStory. Projects page: 14 tag pills (All / Next.js / AI / Education / Astrology / React / Node.js / Healthcare / Ayurveda / Web App / Portfolio / Full-stack / Vedic / Gemstones) — clicking a pill (e.g. 'Web App') toggles the active state and filters the grid; each project card exposes View Live + Case Study actions (5 each visible). Case study /case-study/loexa-africa renders title, metrics, challenge, solution, outcome, tech stack, features. About page renders AboutSectionOne (network mesh + stat chips), AboutSectionTwo (code editor illustration), FounderStory (Tanmay Mishra) and TeamSection. Theme toggle (aria-label='theme toggler') flips html between 'lenis dark' and 'lenis light' on inner pages with no invisible/washed-out text observed in either theme. Global nav 'Process' pill routes to /how-we-work and receives the active pill styling.

issues: Testimonial block not detected by generic text scan — could not conclusively verify the pull-quote text (visual render appears fine). Consider adding data-testid=case-study-testimonial for future automation.

action_items: (Optional/testability) Add data-testid=case-study-testimonial and data-testid=ship-progress-rail so future runs can assert the quote block and rail scale without heuristics.

(Carry-over from iter_1) Supervisor 'frontend' program still points at /app/frontend but the Next.js app lives at /app root — dev server has to be started manually via 'yarn dev' in /app. Please fix supervisor conf or move the app so the site auto-recovers on pod restart.
critical_code_review_comments: ShipStory.tsx correctly gates the animation on useReducedMotion() and provides a 3-column static fallback — good a11y.

Active stage in ShipStory is only signalled via Tailwind class swaps (border-primary/40). Adding an explicit data-active or aria-current attribute on the <button> would make the section easier to test and improve a11y announcements.
Breadcrumb is consistent across inner pages with clickable Home anchor and page-name pill — matches the design system.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://yugantar-main.preview.emergentagent.com. Next.js app at /app root (not /app/frontend); dev server started via 'cd /app && yarn dev'. ShipStory section is 300vh; scroll thresholds are 0-0.34 -> stage0, 0.34-0.67 -> stage1, 0.67-1 -> stage2. Active stage detectable via presence of 'border-primary' class on [data-testid=ship-stage-i]. Theme toggle aria-label='theme toggler'; html root class toggles between 'lenis dark' and 'lenis light'. Projects filter pills are plain <button> elements — active pill has bg-teal-ish highlight. Contact form email backend still intentionally unconfigured — do not treat 500 on /api/contact as a bug.
rca of the issue: n/a — no functional defects reproduced in Phase 2.
